subject: [PATCH 03/10] mm/madvise: factor shared LRU folio handling

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch refactors shared LRU folio handling in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module, extracting common filtering and LRU operations into helper functions to reduce code duplication between huge-PMD and PTE paths. The goal is to simplify the control flow and make it easier to maintain. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
